newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Business services sector started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Business services sector started.

text.p: -- Alex. Brown said it started coverage of the business services sector.
-- It started Caribiner International Inc with a strong buy and COREStaff Inc, Interim Services Inc, Alternative Resources Corp and Robert Half International Inc as buys.
-- Manpower Inc was started as neutral.

-- Caribiner rose 1-1/2 to 39-3/8, COREStaff lost one to 24-1/2, Interim Services was unchanged at 40-5/8, Alternative Resources lost 1/4 to 27-1/2, Robert Half added 7/8 to 37-7/8, and Manpower lost 1/4 to 30-5/8.
